verdict.rationale: gstack ships agent-oriented docs. Its skills are plain SKILL.md files that agent hosts read straight from disk or a checkout. It also publishes a compressed agents digest (gstack-AGENTS.md) meant for agent hosts without a full skill install, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Missing for 10: no llms.txt or llms-full.txt in evidence, the docs-md probe for gstack.md returned 404, and no independent hands-on report of pointing an agent at these docs.
